classification: read-only official OpenAPI research after implementation; not live GitHub run or immutable upstream Git pin
description:
Lists all workflow runs for a repository. You can use parameters to narrow the list of results. For more information about using parameters, see [Parameters](https://docs.github.com/rest/guides/getting-started-with-the-rest-api#parameters).

Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint with a private repository.

This endpoint will return up to 1,000 results for each search when using the following parameters: `actor`, `branch`, `check_suite_id`, `created`, `event`, `head_sha`, `status`.

id.description: The ID of the workflow run.

run_attempt.description: Attempt number of the run, 1 for first attempt and higher if the workflow was re-run.

path.description: The full path of the workflow

head_sha.description: The SHA of the head commit that points to the version of the workflow being run.

display_title.description: The event-specific title associated with the run or the run-name if set, or the value of `run-name` if it is set in the workflow.
